details.title: Step 1: RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 send 3 Subscribe Request Messages to DUT.(Total - 15 active subscriptions) Each subscribe request should contain 3 different paths. They can subscribe to different attributes and events. Once all subscriptions are active, change the value of all the attributes that have been subscribed or trigger an action on the DUT to generate an event.
Step 2a: Factory Reset the DUT and recommission it onto all fabrics. RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 should be on separate, distinct fabrics. RD1 and RD1A should be on the same fabric.

Step 2b: RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 send 3 Subscribe Request Messages to DUT.(Total - 15 active subscriptions) Each subscribe requests should contain 3 different paths. The subscription request from RD1 should contain 4 paths. +
Step 3a: Factory Reset the DUT and recommission it onto all fabrics. RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 should be on separate, distinct fabrics. RD1 and RD1A should be on the same fabric.

Step 3: RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 send 3 Subscribe request messages each with each of them having 3 different paths. Verify that the subscription request messages from all reference devices succeed. Once all the Subscription Requests are activated, RD1 sends 6 subscription request messages with each of them having 3 different paths.
Step 4a: Factory Reset the DUT and recommission it onto all fabrics. RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 should be on separate, distinct fabrics. RD1 and RD1A should be on the same fabric.

Step 4b: RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4, RD5 send 3 Subscribe request messages each with each of them having 3 different paths. Verify that the subscription request messages from RD1, RD2, RD3, RD4 and RD5 succeed. Once all the Subscription Requests are activated, send a Subscribe request messages having 3 different paths from RD1A to the DUT.

native_change.behavior: Each poll can complete one deferred send and receive one datagram. RX cannot starve behind a continuous TX backlog. Empty RX preserves TX completion success; completion errors defer RX; reentry/stop/isolation remain bounded.

BDX_attribution.observed: CSA45 had one QueryImage, successful partial transfer and >=300s stall expiry. After same-provider restart its reason1 UpdateAvailable announcement caused no new QueryImage within240s.
BDX_attribution.cause: Image handoff retains the next daily query. Same-provider UpdateAvailable retains that due time; the 240s observer expired before any new session attempt. Stale CASE was not reached by that particular failure.
